messages:
lauren: FYI customer 'Greenline Health' just sent a 35-question security/compliance questionnaire (SOC2 + HIPAA + GDPR). They want answers within 5 business days. Can we triage and decide owners?
sam: Can you drop the doc link? I can skim and flag obvious infra asks.
lauren: https://redwood.share/secure/greenline-questionnaire-2026.pdf — added to the intake folder. key asks: audit logs, data retention options, encryption details, subprocessors list, and a SOC2 cert timeline.
jin_security: Quick Q — do they use Hosted API or Dedicated capacity or both? That changes controls scope.
maria_sales: They currently run Hosted for prod, evaluating Dedicated for PHI workloads. Sales asked for a complete answers pack + SOC2 evidence if possible.
alex_g: Suggest split into 3 workstreams: 1) Control evidence (SOC2 scope) 2) Data handling & retention policy (GDPR/HIPAA) 3) Infra/network artifacts (logs, encryption). We should decide what is reusable in docs vs what needs a one-off SOW.
jin_security: I'll own Control evidence. I'll pull existing SOC2 artifacts and mark gaps. Target: initial bundle in 3 business days.
sam: I'll take Infra/network artifacts — logs, KMS, VPC diagrams. ETA 2 business days. Will need eng-sre help for retention logs export sample.
alex_g: I'll own Data handling/retention policy + mapping to product features (e.g., retention TTLs, deletion APIs). ETA 4 business days unless we need engineering changes.
maria_sales: Can we also provide an estimated timeline/cost if they need Dedicated + SOC2 evidence within their contract? They want pricing to include any compliance support.
lauren: For prioritization: customer is a target enterprise with pilot contract expected Q2. Mark this P1 for intake and we should respond within 5 business days with an initial package and a roadmap for unresolved items.
jin_security: Proposed triage matrix (quick):
```
Track: Owner - SLA
Control evidence: jin_security - 3d
Data retention: alex_g - 4d
Network & infra: sam - 2d
Legal/third-party: lauren - 5d
```
sam: One more: we should avoid ad-hoc answers that disclose internal ticket IDs. Use canned evidence artifacts where possible -> reduces legal exposure.
lauren: Agreed. I'll draft the response email template and a packaged artifact list (certs, policy docs, config screenshots). I'll ping legal for subprocessors + DPA language.
deploy-bot: New vendor-intake ticket created: VR-3867 (assigned to jin_security)
jin_security: I'll run the gap analysis and sync with legal. Can someone block a 30m sync today? Prefer 3pm PT.
maria_sales: 3pm PT works for sales + customer success.
alex_g: 3pm PT added to my calendar. I'll bring the retention mapping and current product TTLs.
lauren: Great — action items captured. I'll update the intake ticket with owners and the 5d SLA. Thanks all :thumbsup:
